So, Mike is upset because Jason went against his advice and got involved with his ex. From Mike's perspective, he probably felt that Jason was betraying his trust or being disloyal. But is it morally wrong for Jason to do so?

I think about the dynamics here. Mike and Jason might be friends. Mike's ex-girlfriend is involved, and he told Jason not to get with her. Maybe Mike had reasons, like he still cares about her or doesn't want her involved with someone else. But Jason chose to go against that advice.

Is it morally wrong for Jason to do that? Well, in most cases, people have the right to make their own choices, even if others disapprove.
